detail.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity
detail.summary: This research entry synthesizes evidence on functional self-representation, structural governance of autonomous agents, and the limits of cognitive continuity in AI-augmented reasoning, revising the framework for cross-turn accountability.

detail.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity
detail.summary: Persistent self-models and regulatory interfaces, functioning as mechanical constraints on autonomous agents, enable cross-turn accountability by bridging state discontinuities. The revised framework integrates behavioral tracking and authority-limiting architectures.
